questions.solution_text:
$|2x - 9| > 0$
$|2x - 9| \ge 0$ for all real $x$, and $|2x - 9| = 0$ when $2x - 9 = 0 \implies x = \dfrac{9}{2}$.
Therefore, $|2x - 9| > 0$ holds for all real $x$ except $x = \dfrac{9}{2}$.
